desc:
🚛 Drive Through Danger!
Choose your delivery truck and take on the wild Indian mountain roads. The farther you go, the tougher it gets falling boulders, narrow paths, wild weather, and now earthquakes! Can you handle the challenge and make it to the end?

🎮 Join SilverScales Studio – roblox.com/communities/35430412
Get a free Gamepass Truck just for joining the group!

🕹️ Controls:

P: Emergency Brake

L: Headlights

H: Honk

Support the game by liking and favoriting!
